name: younglife-university-map
description: The site itself still has no build step — wrangler runs the admin CMS Worker locally (see wrangler.toml, admin/SETUP.md), and production deploys serve the rest of the repo as static assets unchanged. @cloudflare/puppeteer and pdf-lib are real runtime dependencies though (worker/lib/mapCapture.js, worker/routes/report-pdf.js), not just dev tooling.
